PriorAuthorizationRequest.JustificationText: 35-year-old patient with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, poorly controlled (last HbA1c 9.2% from 6 months ago). Patient presents with symptoms of diabetic retinopathy - blurred vision and difficulty reading. Recent fasting glucose levels consistently above 250 mg/dL despite maximum metformin therapy. Requires comprehensive diabetes management including glycemic control assessment and retinal screening for complications. Patient is motivated and adherent to prescribed medications. Family history of diabetes and cardiovascular disease.

ServiceRequest.ct:ActivityInstructions: Hemoglobin A1c test for diabetes monitoring - assessing 3-month glucose control in poorly controlled Type 2 diabetes patient
Comprehensive metabolic panel including glucose, creatinine, and electrolytes for diabetes complications screening
Comprehensive eye examination with ophthalmoscopy for diabetic retinopathy screening - patient reports visual symptoms
Diabetes self-management education session focusing on glucose monitoring and medication adherence
